Human-Agent Principle Distillation

4:52LS20 · OfficialOctober 24, 2026
Watch on YouTubeYanik_AI channel

About this episode

Official LS20 is the setting for Human-Agent Principle Distillation. An SRA run produces evidence about where its reasoning stops being sufficient. Yannick examines that evidence and identifies a principle that could apply more broadly. A coding agent integrates the principle, and the next run tests its use. The episode describes this development cycle and the need to connect new knowledge to existing structure so that it can support later discoveries.

  • Reusable principles
  • Evidence from failure
  • Human and coding-agent feedback
